traditional: A 多到 B 處理唔切
jyutping: A do1 dou3 B cyu5 lei5 m4 cit3

english.note: Use this colloquial pattern when information, work, or other things become too numerous for someone to handle.

examples.english: Alex has so many files to handle that they could drown him.
examples.traditional: 文件多到阿明處理唔切。
examples.jyutping: man4 gin6 do1 dou3 aa3 ming4 cyu5 lei5 m4 cit3
